patch_description: The current program spends its 17s budget on only 16 seeds each followed by expensive exact hill-climbing. The funnel design principle says: broad cheap global search first, expensive exact refinement last. New configuration: (1) ~72 diverse deterministic seeds (polygons, double/triple rings, 3-fold symmetric orbits, jittered lattices, seeded random restarts); (2) a fast vectorized softmin-gradient ascent (~300 iterations, annealed sharpness) on every seed to pull each toward a good basin — this is cheap because it uses vectorized bincount gradients rather than exact evaluations; (3) rank all candidates by the exact ratio (min triangle area / hull area); (4) exact stochastic hill-climbing polish (single-point moves with adaptive amplitude and restart-on-improvement) on the top 12 candidates, with a time-budget guard. This broadens multi-start coverage ~4.5x while keeping per-candidate cost low, which is the demonstrated mechanism for escaping the 0.02 plateau. Determinism is preserved via fixed seeds and no wall-clock dependence in results (the time guard only caps work, and iteration counts are fixed).
